output.headline: Moves $6,750.00 at Castlemont High from a career-tech teacher position to newcomer pathway equipment
output.summary: On the Measures N and H Commission's recommendation, the Board is asked to change Castlemont High School's 2025-2026 Education Improvement Plan budget. The line to hire a career technical education (CTE) teacher at 0.62 of a full-time position drops from $20,200.00 to $13,450.00, and a new $6,750.00 line buys equipment for the International (Newcomer) pathway classes. This shifts money within the school's plan.
